name: Pro Integration Tests
on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'pro/**'

  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

          submodules: recursive

        run: npm ci

        run: |
          if [ ! -d "pro" ]; then
            echo "Pro submodule not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Pro submodule found"

      - name: Run Pro integration tests
        if: steps.validate_pro.outcome == 'success'
        run: npm run test:pro

      - name: Run Pro internal unit tests
        if: steps.validate_pro.outcome == 'success'
        run: npm run test:pro:internal

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always() && steps.validate_pro.outcome == 'success'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4

          name: test-results
